cards.text:
D-SS02/001EN
Sealed Blaze Dragon, Aaushniya
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), perform all of the following according to the Arms on your (VC).
・Right Deity Arms‐This unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
・Left Deity Arms‐[COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose a grade 1 or less card from your drop, and call it to (RC).

D-SS02/002EN
Blaze Maiden, Amelia
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[ACT](RC):If you have a vanguard with "Nirvana" in its card name, and your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & put this unit into your soul], choose up to one unit card with "Nirvana" in its card name from your hand, and ride it as [Stand]. If you rode, you cannot ride by card effects until end of turn.

D-SS02/003EN
Desire Devil, Dofund
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this card is placed on (RC) from hand, if your vanguard is "Avaricious Demonic Dragon, Greedon", you may [Soul-Charge 2].
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if your soul has two or more "Avaricious Demonic Dragon, Greedon", [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Critical] +1 until end of that battle.

D-SS02/004EN
Diabolos Madonna, Meagan
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if you are in "Final Rush", this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

D-SS02/005EN
Cardinal Dominus, Orfist Regis
Normal Unit｜ Brandt Gate｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), choose up to one World card from your hand or drop, and put it into your Order Zone.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if your World is Abyssal Dark Night, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & discard a card from your hand], and for every two World cards in your Order Zone, call up to one Shadow Army token to (RC), and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle. (If there are four World cards, [Power] +10000)

D-SS02/006EN
Aurora Battle Princess, Launcher Charleen
Normal Unit｜ Brandt Gate｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):During the battle that this unit attacked, your opponent cannot call normal units from hand to (GC), and cannot play Blitz orders from hand.
[CONT](RC):If the number of your opponent's cards imprisoned in your Prison is five or less, this unit cannot attack.

D-SS02/007EN
Gravidia Peters
Normal Unit｜ Brandt Gate｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield
[AUTO](RC):When the attack this unit boosted hits, choose up to two Meteorite cards from your drop, and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you put two cards, retire this unit, and draw a card.

D-SS02/008EN
Heavenly Command Dragon, Exalute Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), if you have a vanguard with "Bastion" in its card name, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Bard of the Heavenly Instrument, Lutente", call it to a (RC) in the same column as this unit, and shuffle your deck.

D-SS02/009EN
Dead Sea Spiritualist, Grave゠Zorga
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT](VC):If you did Alchemagic this turn, all of your front row units get [Power] +5000.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1 & Discard a card from your hand], choose a normal order from your drop, put it into your hand, and until end of turn, when you would play a normal order, you can bind a normal order with a different card name from your drop, and Alchemagic. (Combine the costs, and add the effect to the back!)

Normal Order｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power ｜ Shield 5000

At the end of that battle, if your opponent's damage zone has four or less cards, [COST][Counter-Blast 2 & put this card into your drop], choose one of your opponent's vanguards, and deal one damage.
